title: Creamy Vegan Dill Pickle Salad and Garydn Review!
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldKeywords: beans, best vegan salad dressing, creamy, dill, dill pickle, dressing, healty, oil-free, pickle, salad, vegan
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup raw cashews ((see step 1 for prep))
2 tablespoon dill pickle juice ((the liquid in the pickle jar))
2 teaspoons fresh dill ((or 1/2 teaspoon dried dill))
1 can (19oz) white bean (lima beans, chickpeas, or white kidney beans) (drained and rinsed)
1 cup cherry or grape tomatoes, (sliced in half)
1 pinch red pepper flakes for garnish ((optional))

ldNutritionRaw.servingSize: 1 serving (1/4 of the dressing and 1/4 of the salad)
